lead_fa: Balance خورشید و ماه را کنترل می‌کند: با ورود به [[Moonkin Form]] و مدیریت [[Eclipse]] و [[Celestial Alignment]] پنجره‌های برست می‌سازی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Keeper of the Grove]] با پنجرهٔ Treant های Force of Nature و [[Elune's Chosen]] با چرخهٔ [[Fury of Elune]].

strengths: Sustained multi-target damage via Starfall, Moonfire, Sunfire and Starfire
Huge control and utility toolkit: Innervate, Entangling Roots, Soothe, Typhoon, plus Mass Entanglement or Incapacitating Roar
Talent diversity: Starweaver/Rattle the Stars and Incarnation: Chosen of Elune/Convoke the Spirits are interchangeable with both hero talents
weaknesses: Long AoE ramp: spread Moonfire on as many targets as possible before damage windows
Steep learning curve: talent interactions are hard to grasp at a glance
Optimizing Eclipse together with Celestial Alignment/Incarnation windows requires research

season2_changes: Stellar Amplification now limited to 1 target; casting Starsurge on a new target moves the debuff
Bounteous Bloom now increases Treant duration by 4s instead of spawning an extra Treant
Star Cascade no longer procs from Wrath; proc chance 30% (was 40%) for a 50% damage Starsurge (was 70%)
Sculpt the Stars swapped places with Astral Communion in the spec tree
Orbit Breaker is now trackable in the default Cooldown Manager
Overall: spender damage up, Astral Power generation slightly down; hero talent gap narrowed

hero.recommendation: Elune's Chosen carries the (Best) tags for Raid and Mythic+ in the current tables; Keeper of the Grove remains fully viable and plays around Force of Nature windows.
hero.keeper_of_the_grove: Damage windows tied to Force of Nature Treants, each granting Harmony of the Grove damage buffs. Early Spring lowers FoN's cooldown; Bounteous Bloom extends Treant duration by 4s. Control of the Dream reduces CA/FoN/Convoke cooldown by their unused time (cap 15s). Plan Eclipse and Celestial Alignment windows around Force of Nature.
hero.elunes_chosen: Revolves around pressing Starfire in Lunar Eclipse to reduce Fury of Elune's cooldown; juggle Lunar Eclipse with Celestial Alignment and send Fury of Elune on cooldown (with Lunation).
hero.eclipse_rule: You cannot press Eclipse during the Celestial Alignment window; pressing Celestial Alignment during an Eclipse window cancels the current buff and applies a new one.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Balance Druid Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/druid/balance/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Juggle the Eclipse cooldown with Celestial Alignment/Incarnation: Chosen of Elune; never lose a use of either.
Spread Moonfire before AoE windows; Balance's multi-target power ramps after DoTs are out.
Pool Astral Power for burst windows (e.g. Celestial Alignment with an on-use trinket) without losing casts or buff uptime.

st_keeper: Eclipse if sitting at two charges
Sunfire if it will expire before the upcoming Incarnation window ends
Fury of Elune if available before using Force of Nature
Force of Nature if you have enough Astral Power for three Starsurge casts and either Celestial Alignment or Eclipse is available
On-Use Trinket together with Celestial Alignment
Celestial Alignment with the next GCD after Force of Nature (or if the fight ends before FoN is back)
Eclipse with the next GCD after Force of Nature

Outside Eclipse: refresh Moonfire in Pandemic if it falls off before the next Force of Nature; refresh Sunfire in Pandemic; Eclipse with AP for two Starsurges before the next FoN+CA overlap; Starsurge to avoid capping or with Touch the Cosmos; Wrath to generate AP

During Eclipse: Convoke the Spirits during the FoN window when you can no longer spend AP; Fury of Elune if FoN's remaining cooldown is longer than 5s; Starsurge for Ascendant Eclipses stacks / Touch the Cosmos / movement; Starsurge if the window is ending and pooling is safe; refresh Moonfire and Sunfire if inactive; Wild Mushroom for AP and movement; Wrath to generate AP
st_elunes: Lunar Eclipse if sitting at two charges
Moonfire and Sunfire if they will expire before the upcoming Celestial Alignment window ends
Fury of Elune if you have AP for two Starsurge casts and either CA or Lunar Eclipse is available
On-Use Trinket together with Celestial Alignment
Celestial Alignment with the GCD after Fury of Elune (or if the fight ends before FoE is back)
Lunar Eclipse with the GCD after Fury of Elune
Send Fury of Elune on cooldown if playing Lunation

Outside Eclipse: refresh Moonfire/Sunfire in Pandemic; Lunar Eclipse with AP for two Starsurges before the next FoE+CA overlap; Starsurge to avoid capping or with Touch the Cosmos; Starfire to generate AP

During Eclipse: Convoke the Spirits during CA when you can no longer spend AP; Starsurge for Ascendant Eclipses/Touch the Cosmos/movement; Starsurge when the window ends and pooling is safe; refresh Moonfire/Sunfire; Wild Mushroom for AP; Starfire to generate AP
aoe_keeper: Spread Moonfire while targets are being gathered
Sunfire when all targets are gathered
Force of Nature if not in an Eclipse and the next cast is Eclipse or Incarnation
Incarnation: Chosen of Elune right after Force of Nature
Enter Lunar Eclipse on 4+ targets; enter Solar Eclipse up to 3 targets (with AP for two Ascendant Eclipses spends)
Starsurge to consume Starweaver's Weft; Starfall to consume Starweaver's Warp
Starfire at the start of Incarnation to consume Ascendant Fires
Starfall to prevent AP capping or consume Ascendant Eclipses at Eclipse start
Wrath outside Eclipse up to 4 targets; Starfire in Lunar Eclipse and Wrath in Solar Eclipse
rotation.aoe_breakpoints: Solar Eclipse + Wrath up to 3 targets; Lunar Eclipse + Starfire on 4+ targets; always cast Starfire once inside Incarnation to spend Ascendant Fires in AoE; press Starfire during Incarnation on 3+ targets.
rotation.opener_note: Start casting ~4 seconds before the pull with three Wrath casts (free damage and Touch the Cosmos proc chances); entering Eclipse at the very start of combat is generally optimal. Openers vary per fight and talents (Fury of Elune, Convoke, Wild Mushroom must be fitted in).

gear.gearing_rules: Intellect > Mastery > Crit = Haste > Versatility as a rule; with KotG + Convoke take less Haste and more Crit (Convoke does not scale with Haste); Elune's Chosen values Haste more (Mastery/Haste/Crit spread evenly). Astral Smolder (Apex) skyrocketed Crit value. On-use trinkets are strong. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Bark of the Enigmatic Dreamwatcher
tier_set.pc2: Starsurge damage increased by 20%. Starfall also deals some Astral damage instantly to all valid enemies in range when cast.
tier_set.pc4: Your damage is increased by 10% while in any Eclipse; the bonus wanes to 2% at the midpoint and waxes back to 10% at the end.
tier_set.note: Play around dumping Astral Power at the start and end of Eclipse windows unless pooling for a bigger burst window (CA + on-use trinket).

notes: Mastery is generally the best secondary; Astral Smolder pushed Crit's value way up.
KotG with Convoke: less Haste, more Crit. Elune's Chosen: Haste rises to even spread.
Sim your character for exact splits.

mplus.hero_note: Elune's Chosen is the current Best-tagged build for Mythic+; Keeper of the Grove is interchangeable depending on preference.
tips: Start spreading Moonfire during the gather; Sunfire when the pack is settled; your damage ramps after DoTs.
Control utilities (Typhoon, Mass Entanglement, Entangling Roots, Soothe) are part of your value as a Druid.
Innervate a healer on longer fights.
